name: Ace Anderson
source:
The game's protagonist, Ace Anderson is a college freshman still trying to find his way at Olympus University, the all-boys sports college. Indecisive and a bit lazy, Ace has yet to pick a major or find any club that suits him. Ace has always been hopeful of finding purpose in his seemingly dull life, and little does he know that everything is about to change for him when he starts anew in Jock Studio!

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/jock-studio/]BLits[/url]]
